entries.source: SDK 16.4 and 26.2 PHASE.framework, byte-identical on the default lines; PHASE arrived in iOS 15 and the port's releases are 6.1.3 and 4.3, so there is no PHASE.framework on either and every value is the header's own, compared against a fresh object of the host's own PHASE by tests/backports/host/phase/run.sh, which also holds the port's own renamed classes to the same numbers; the documented default for this class is at PHASEDirectivityModel.h:134 (subbandParameters, no documented default)
